findings.fact: Roman public business and magistrate/augural authority are part of the reported institution. Ordinary bird watching or a user-entered sighting is not thereby an authorized public auspice. Marcus later questions contemporary practice and avoidance of unwanted signs.

Quintus argues for divination inBookI; Marcus counters inBookII. Preserve source claims and objections together; do not label every quoted tradition as Cicero endorsement or verified predictive success.

findings.layer: Main translated text, independently checked Latin clause
findings.fact: Reported calls associate crow/cornix with left and raven/corvus with right. Latin has cornicem a laeva and corvum ab dextera with canere. The clause discusses sign causation; its polarity is not independently asserted as favorable merely by borrowing a flight passage.

Explicitly describes an augur treating raven flight to right or crow flight to left as favorable. Keep flight versus call evidence separate and keep this attribution distinct from an actual event outcome.

Alites give signs through flight; oscines through cries. Note133 supplies eagle/hawk/osprey and raven/crow/owl examples with Festus lead. These are not a modern taxonomy or permission to erase explicitly reported corvid flight inI.39.85.

findings.layer: Critical main text and conflicting editorial note
findings.fact: Marcus contrasts national direction conventions, notes favorable signs can be called sinistra even when physically right, and criticizes inconsistency. Note226 says Roman observer south/Greek north, but gives a right-side crow-call example conflicting with main text crow-left. Do not silently correct, universalize or infer observer heading from that note.

Questions a victory interpretation of crowing cocks and proposes ordinary/chance causes, including an attributed Democritus digestion account. This is argument/history, not an independently validated biological mechanism.

Bird-related weather signs appear in an analogy expressly introduced outside divination. Historical heron/nightingale/crow labels and behaviors need their own textual qualifications. No Aeromancy rule transfer, real weather forecast or supernatural certification.

findings.layer: Independent Greek literary narrative, Murray1924 translation
findings.fact: Eagle passes left of Trojan host carrying a live snake; snake strikes it, eagle drops snake and departs crying. Polydamas interprets failure to bring prey home as warning against attack/anticipated costly retreat. Species+left alone omits the decisive sequence and interpreter.

Hector rejects Polydamas bird-reading advice in favor of his account of Zeus/patriotic duty. His speech mentions right toward dawn/sun and left toward darkness; retain as narrative wording, not a universal Greek observer-facing rule.

Hecabe and Priam seek a right-side messenger before the ransom journey; Zeus sends an eagle appearing right and the onlookers are cheered. Keep request, journey, character response and narrative report; it is not a universal right-eagle prediction or empirical outcome trial.
Retain ancient/source bird labels separately from modern scientific species IDs. No Latin binomial or current habitat range is inferred from crow/raven/black-eagle wording.

first_candidate.name: Cicero/Falconer1923 manual bird-sign source-condition reference
first_candidate.priority: Freeze a complete bounded Roman subset of explicitly attributed source conditions and contrasting criticism before implementation; source-located documentary matcher is feasible and substantive without simulating birds or importing a generic bird dictionary.
first_candidate.scope: At minimum preserveI.7.12 call-side accounts,I.39.85 explicitly favorable flight accounts,I.53.120 classification context andII.38–39 skeptical/conflicting context as separate records. The exact supported matrix must name which fields are direct, compositional or unresolved.
first_candidate.matching: Exact source bird label,phenomenon and relative relation; unknown,opposite or unmatched cases remain unresolved rather than unfavorable. No mixing call/flight propositions or adopting note226 as universal orientation law.
first_candidate.output: Manual observation trace; matched source condition/locator/speaker; source-attributed account; missing evidence and conflicting notes; raw user question/uncertainty; exact offline JSON/Markdown replay. No actual divine/public decision or event prediction.
first_candidate.core_gate: Before code inspect/freeze complete proposed subset and independent known answers. Do not close with a generic journal or source-free species list. If directional/context evidence remains inadequate, narrow to a supported documentary comparison scope rather than inventing a universal augural system.
